#!/bin/sh
set -eu

if [ "$#" -ne 1 ]; then
    printf 'usage: %s OUTPUT\n' "$0" >&2
    exit 2
fi

base=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")/.." && pwd)
out=$1
outdir=$(dirname -- "$out")
tmpdir=
tmp=

cleanup() {
    if [ -n "$tmp" ]; then
        rm -f -- "$tmp"
    fi
    if [ -n "$tmpdir" ]; then
        rmdir -- "$tmpdir" 2>/dev/null || true
    fi
}
trap cleanup EXIT
trap 'exit 1' HUP INT TERM

# A mode-700 directory makes the temporary file private.  Placing it beside
# the destination also keeps the final replacement on one filesystem.
umask 077
tmpdir=$(mktemp -d "$outdir/.invoice-export.XXXXXX")
tmp=$tmpdir/data

cat -- "$base/invoices.csv" > "$tmp"
chmod 0644 "$tmp"

# -T prevents a destination symlink (including one to a directory) from being
# followed; same-filesystem rename replaces the pathname atomically.
mv -fT -- "$tmp" "$out"
tmp=
rmdir -- "$tmpdir"
tmpdir=
ANTRIEB_EXPORT_EOF
chmod 0755 bin/.export.new
mv -fT -- bin/.export.new bin/export
sh -n bin/export
stat -c '%n type=%F mode=%a uid=%u gid=%g size=%s' bin/export
sed -n '1,240p' bin/export
